favourite.heading: Why Coastal Carolina can pull away
bullets: Playing at Coastal Carolina is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

Coastal Carolina is the better football team by 0.7 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+0.7 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 0.4 points to Coastal Carolina (+0.4 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Liberty can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Liberty by 1.1 points: ball control vs front disruption (-1.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -19.0 to p90 +25.0 for Coastal Carolina, so a projection of +4.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
